input.topic: Rereading your notes is the worst way to study for an exam

hook: Stop rereading your notes if you want to pass your exam tomorrow.
body:
When you reread, your brain mistakes recognition for learning. You think you know it just because it looks familiar.

But recognition is passive. To actually lock it in, you have to force your brain to retrieve the information.

Close the book and test yourself instead. If it doesn't feel hard, you aren't studying.
cta: Save this video to use before your next exam.
